tool_args.rationale: The available smooth, low-dimensional state/input response is a pragmatic alternative after the memory ODE was refuted. The only further acquired probe duplicated an existing observation and did not resolve the mechanism; the reported rows do not show chaotic sign oscillations that would justify scoped abstention.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired probe returned a duplicate of an existing zero-gradient row, so it adds no information to distinguish mechanisms.
Its fresh confirmation RMSE was 1.5185, far above tolerance, so this mechanism is not supported.
The observed short-horizon rows show mixed response across matched input contrasts; no slow-horizon observation supports identifying its reversal parameters.
